XAUUSD.description: trend breakout, ATR stop, trailing or channel exit
trend pullback to the fast EMA, fixed reward:risk
session VWAP pullback with the VWAP slope (tick-volume weighted)
breakout confirmed by a tick-volume surge (order-flow proxy)
RSI(2) mean reversion with the 200-bar trend
fade back inside the band, exit at the mean
